programme.title: Lamb of God: Killadelphia
programme.desc: Lamb of God's Killadelphia showcases the thrash-metal band at The Trocadero in 2005, featuring a recorded set, candid footage, and an all-access portrait.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Lizzo shows up fully in everything she does, tracing her journey from a diamond record to a fall tour.

programme.title: Kings of Leon: Live at The O2 London, England
programme.desc: Kings of Leon performs live at The O2 in London, delivering hits like Sex on Fire and Use Somebody in a high-energy set.

programme.title: AJ Rafael: Take Me Back Tour From Gramercy Theatre
programme.desc: Experience AJ Rafael’s heartfelt “Take Me Back Tour” live from New York City’s Gramercy Theatre. Blending nostalgia and artistry, AJ performs fan favorites and new tracks including “Take Me Back,” “Showstopper,” and “I Just Want You.” Through soulful storytelling, intimate moments, and emotional performances, AJ reflects on his journey from the early Myspace and YouTube days to becoming one of the most beloved independent singer-songwriters of his generation.

programme.title: Bowling For Soup: Live and Very Attractive
programme.desc: Bowling for Soup performs live on a U.K. tour, delivering hits like 1985 and Girl All The Bad Guys Want with high-energy pop-punk style.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Actor, comedian, and master impressionist Jay Pharoah joins Joel Madden for a candid talk about early jobs, lessons from Charlie Murphy, and finding joy in comedy. Pharoah shares stories from his time on the road, his new special Jared, and how humor became his way to connect and uplift others.

programme.title: P!NK: The Truth About Love Tour - Live From Melbourne
programme.desc: P!NK performs a high-energy 2013 concert in Melbourne, featuring acrobatics, pyrotechnics, and hits like So What and Try.

programme.title: The Voidz: Tomorrow A Special
programme.desc: The Voidz perform live in a special TOMORROW! episode, offering an immersive look into their experimental sound and creative world.

programme.title: New Order on Power, Corruption & Lies
programme.desc: Record On explores the making of New Order’s groundbreaking 1983 album Power, Corruption & Lies and its defining single “Blue Monday.” Featuring Bernard Sumner, Peter Hook, Stephen Morris, and Gillian Gilbert, the episode examines how the band evolved from the tragedy of Joy Division into pioneering electronic innovators inspired by New York’s club scene.

programme.title: Carmen Christopher: Live from the Windy City
programme.desc: Comedian Carmen Christopher returns home to Chicago for a sharp, surreal, and hilarious stand-up special that blends the absurd with the heartfelt. With quick wit and offbeat honesty, Christopher riffs on social media, family, dating, politics, and Midwest life in a performance that’s both painfully self-aware and laugh-out-loud ridiculous. Executive produced by Tim Robinson and Zach Kanin.

programme.title: Every Other Summer
programme.desc: Every Other Summer is a documentary about Solid Sound Festival by Wilco. Shot in 2013, it features performances by Wilco, Neko Case, and others.

programme.title: 10 Years of Noise and Confusion: Oasis Live at Barrowlands
programme.desc: Filmed live at Glasgow’s Barrowlands, Oasis performs Supersonic, Roll With It, and more in a “back to the roots” anniversary show capturing their raw live energy.

programme.title: Lettuce with the Colorado Symphony
programme.desc: A genre-bending concert film where funk titans Lettuce join the Colorado Symphony for a thrilling night of symphonic groove. Guided by conductor Chris Dragon and orchestrations by Tom Hagerman, the set amplifies Lettuce’s deep-pocket improvisation with orchestral color—spotlighting searing solos, lush brass and strings, and reimagined moments from Mozart to Curtis Mayfield and Tears for Fears. Shot in Denver, the performance captures the band’s chemistry, the orchestra’s power, and the communal lift of “symphonic funk.”

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: In this episode of Artist Friendly, Joel Madden sits down with Grammy Award-winning singer and songwriter Tori Kelly to talk about her new self-titled album TORI and her upcoming tour. Kelly opens up about artistic evolution, learning to embrace fun and authenticity in her 30s, and the creative freedom she found working with producer Jon Bellion. From her viral YouTube beginnings to her renewed confidence as a performer, Tori reflects on her journey, her faith, and the balance between art and commerce in the music industry.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.sub-title: Bobby of Bob Vylan on Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Bobby from the British punk-rap duo Bob Vylan joins Joel Madden for an unfiltered conversation about self-determination, identity, and breaking barriers in music. Bobby opens up about growing up between London and Ipswich, navigating racism, finding purpose through education, and how his lived experiences fuel the band’s powerful, socially charged sound.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Después de miles de horas de preparación minuciosa y vuelo peligroso, un terrible accidente devasta a la tripulación de los bombarderos de agua en Turquía, y a todos en Buffalo. La primera carrera de Wilf como azafata levanta las cejas entre el personal. Y un aficionado a los aviones escoceses cumple el sueño de su vida cuando Joe lo deja viajar en el asiento del capitán de su DC-3.

Scott recibe la noticia de que debe retirarse del vuelo para que otro copiloto pueda acelerar el paso al capitán. Él hace todo lo posible para asegurar una nueva carta, pero su rival también quiere volar el nuevo trabajo.

Y después de una visita de su madre, el destino le lanza a Scott una inesperada bola curva.

programme.title: La Fiebre del Jade
programme.desc: Gary y su hijo rescatan un viejo camión del ejército, pero conducirlo hasta la mina es brutal.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Es cierto: lo bueno en exceso puede ser malo. Cuando se produce un accidente que afecta a la fórmula mágica de Papá Pitufo y este acaba duplicado, los Pitufos se muestran encantados: dos Papás Pitufo pueden dar el doble de buenos consejos y el doble de amor que uno solo. Sin embargo, después de un tiempo, las cosas se complican en exceso en la aldea. ¡Sobre todo cuando otro accidente hace que Gargamel también se duplique!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cuando se produce una emergencia, todos los Pitufos de la aldea dejan lo que tienen entre manos y corren a oír las noticias. Pero que Pitufo Vanidoso convoque una asamblea para que los Pitufos puedan admirar su nuevo gorro es pasarse de la raya. Le echan de la aldea y Pitufo Vanidoso tiene la mala suerte de encontrarse con Lofty, el elfo, que le recomienda darse un horrible baño de fango…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Te despiertas temprano por la mañana, antes de que los demás Pitufos se hayan levantado de sus camas, para preparar sabrosos bizcochos de pitufrutas. Dedicas toda la mañana a preparar pitufimanjares para el almuerzo. Después, toda la tarde a tener la deliciosa cena lista a tiempo. ¿Y acaso los demás Pitufos te dan siquiera las gracias? Así pues, Pitufo Goloso renuncia. La aldea está en problemas… y pronto, también lo está Pitufo Goloso.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos ayudan a una reina de las hadas a vencer al malvado Falan, que intenta robar el sonajero mágico de su hijo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Soñador desea encontrar vida extraterrestre pero en la Aldea se burlan de él. Nadie le creerá cuando les diga que ha hablado con un ser de otro planeta.

programme.title: Pitufos Helados
programme.desc: El invierno ha llegado y los Pitufos están a punto de sucumbir al intenso frío. ¿Podrá Pitufo Rastreador encontrar el remedio sin caer en las garras de Gargamel?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Todos los Pitufos quieren un poema escrito para cada uno de ellos. Pitufo Poeta se siente superado por la presión y decide huir en busca de inspiración. El rey Fiera Bestia captura a Pitufo Poeta y lo obliga a escribir un poema para animar a su hija. Pitufo Poeta descubre que la motivación debe nacer del corazón, y nunca de la obligación.

programme.title: Pitufo Sobre Ruedas
programme.desc: Cada año, todos los Pitufos recorren la larga senda hasta llegar a unos manantiales termales de ensueño. Sin embargo, este año únicamente Abuelo Pitufo, Papá Pitufo y Pitufo Natural harán la caminata hasta ese lugar. Los demás Pitufos están demasiado atareados (o son demasiado vagos) como para caminar. Entonces, Pitufo Carpintero llega con lo que él llama su pitufurgón personalizado. Ya no es necesario andar: basta con ir sobre ruedas hasta allí… Por supuesto, las cosas no serán tan sencillas como parecen.

programme.title: Conociendo El Futuro
programme.desc: Baltasar el encantador es un hombre con visión. Sabe que la era de la alquimia está llegando a su fin. El futuro pertenecerá a aquellos que comprendan la ciencia, pero… ¿cómo puede conocer el futuro? Quizá secuestrando a Padre Tiempo. Los Pitufos ayudarán a arreglar la situación después de que Pequeño Trueno, un dinosaurio, escape a través de una rotura en el tejido del tiempo.

programme.title: El Genio De Granjero
programme.desc: Pitufo Labrador se pregunta qué hace una calabaza en el melonar, cuando debería estar junto a los colinabos. Cuando Pitufo Labrador tira de la calabaza y la separa del suelo, libera a un genio que comienza a llamarle amo e insiste en concederle deseos. El ansia del genio, llamado Gourdy, por complacer a Pitufo Labrador hará que, más que en una ayuda, se convierta en una molestia.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Enfermizo se convierte en un héroe cuando se olvida de sus dolencias y salva al resto de los Pitufos de las peligrosas flores del olvido.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado brujo Gargamel pide al mago Balthazar una receta para capturar a los pitufos. Implica secuestrar a la Madre Naturaleza para impedir la llegada de la Primavera. Por suerte, los pitufos salvan la situación.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Fortachón descubre a un caballero que lo ayuda a combatir a un Dragón, pero éste huye y deja a Fortachón defendiendo a los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Todo Esta Bien Si Termina Bien
programme.desc: El robo del oro de las hadas por parte de Gargamel casi lleva a la guerra a los Pitufos con las hadas.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: En su plan por librarse de los Pitufos, Gargamel le lanza un hechizo a Gigantón y se disfraza de Pitufo. Creyendo que es un Pitufo, Gigantón está a punto de destrozar por completo la Aldea Pitufa hasta que Papá Pitufo acude con una cura.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Soñador desea encontrar vida extraterrestre pero en la Aldea se burlan de él. Nadie le creerá cuando les diga que ha hablado con un ser de otro planeta.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel consigue transformar una colcha en una alfombra voladora, lo que hace inevitable que se produzcan accidentes. El resultado de uno de esos accidentes es que un trozo de la tela voladora acaba utilizándose como pañal para Bebé Pitufo, con resultados realmente sorprendentes…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: A veces ocurren accidentes. ¡En esta ocasión, un error de Pitufo Bromista hace que su sombra cobre vida! Y a la sombra le encanta hacer bromas a todos los habitantes de la Aldea Pitufa…

programme.title: Dilo Por Ti Mismo, Granjero
programme.desc: Pitufo Labrador esconde su amor por Pitufina ocultándose en el anonimato y enviándole poemas. Cuando finalmente se encuentran, Gigantón les captura y, en sus esfuerzos por escapar, descubren su afecto mutuo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El pantano de Greenpeedeepee es el único lugar donde se pueden encontrar unas algas que son el delicioso e imprescindible ingrediente del famoso estofado de algas de Pitufo Goloso. Desafortunadamente, también es un lugar donde te puedes topar con los desagradables Verrugosos. A pesar de que Sasita y los Pitufos le salvan la vida a un joven Verrugoso, acaban siendo apresados por los demás. ¡Pero el Enmascarado Escarlata los salvará! Quizá…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos van al rescate de dos niños y su abuelo, cuando un misterioso extranjero aparece haciendo que su trineo se rompa en pedazos. Al llamar a la puerta de Gargamel en busca de ayuda, no se dan cuenta de que están poniendo en peligro sus vidas y la de los Pitufos...

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos llevan a Abuelo Pitufo al castillo del rey para que pueda conocer a Guillermo. Pero, entre una cosa y otra (sobre todo otra), los Pitufos y Guillermo acaban a bordo de una gran nave vikinga. Los vikingos creen que Guillermo es su mítico gran guerrero, aquel que derrotará al Rey Tormenta. ¿Podrán los Pitufos ayudar a Guillermo a salir de este embrollo?

programme.title: El Pitufofantasma
programme.desc: Guillermo se encuentra en el castillo de sus amigos Selwyn y Tallulah cuando el tío Fenwick, el amigable fantasma, le pide ayuda para atrapar a algunos parientes que le acechan. Guillermo acude a los Pitufos en busca de ayuda, y así comienza una divertida persecución…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Viaje Al Pitufo De La Tierra
programme.desc: El invierno ha llegado a la Aldea Pitufa. Y los pequeños Pitufos están helados de frío. ¿Pero qué está haciendo Pitufo Torpe con esa extraña roca que ha descubierto? ¿Y por qué está tan entusiasmado Pitufo Minero con su nuevo descubrimiento? Nadie entiende a qué se debe tanto revuelo por una simple nueva roca para la colección de Pitufo Torpe… Al adentrarse bajo tierra, los Pitufos encontrarán peligros y sorpresas.

programme.title: Una Campana Para Azrael
programme.desc: Gargamel lanza un hechizo a una campana atada a la cola de Azrael que conducirá al gato hasta los Pitufos. Pero Papá Pitufo es más astuto que él y lanza un contra hechizo que lleva al mago hasta Gigantón, en lugar de hasta los deliciosos Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo se siente preparado para la ocasión cuando empieza a preparar una receta de galletas. Está convencido de que va a ganar el concurso, ya que ha tomado prestada una receta del libro de magia de Papá Pitufo. Sin embargo, una gran sorpresa y algunas situaciones desagradables aguardan al pobre Pitufo Filósofo y a toda la aldea.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cuando el hada de las flores aparece en el pueblo de los Pitufos, todos se enamoran de su encanto e inteligencia. Y pronto se darán cuenta de que se convertirá en una especie de mamá pitufo para todos…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel ha echado tantas sustancias tóxicas en su estanque que el agua se vuelve encantada. Tras caerse en el estanque, Gargamel se vuelve pequeño, tan pequeño que Papá Pitufo tendrá que salvarlo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Te despiertas temprano por la mañana, antes de que los demás Pitufos se hayan levantado de sus camas, para preparar sabrosos bizcochos de pitufrutas. Dedicas toda la mañana a preparar pitufimanjares para el almuerzo. Después, toda la tarde a tener la deliciosa cena lista a tiempo. ¿Y acaso los demás Pitufos te dan siquiera las gracias? Así pues, Pitufo Goloso renuncia. La aldea está en problemas… y pronto, también lo está Pitufo Goloso.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo lo ha vuelto a hacer. Además, esta vez ha sido delante de Papá Pitufo. Ha pronunciado un hechizo que convierte todo en piedra. Todo, incluyendo a él mismo y a los demás Pitufos, así como la aldea y muchos kilómetros del bosque que hay alrededor. Afortunadamente, aparece Guillermo.

programme.title: Lenguaje De Señas
programme.desc: Los Pitufos conocen a un elfo del bosque, que les enseña la lengua de signos después de que Gargamel les administre una poción de enmudecimiento.

programme.title: El Castillo De Las Disputas
programme.desc: En el Castillo de las Disputas casi nunca se escuchan palabras amables. El brujo Selwyn y su pareja, la bruja Tallulah, se pasan el tiempo discutiendo. Tharp, la gárgola que tienen como mascota, se refugia en la Aldea Pitufa. Pero algo terrible va a suceder…

programme.title: El Libro De Bromas De Bromista
programme.desc: Las cajas sorpresa de Pitufo Bromista ya no resultan divertidas para los demás Pitufos. Pitufo Bromista busca nuevas ideas en su «Gran libro de las bromas», pero esas ideas son aún peor recibidas en la aldea. Y entonces, Gargamel llega con algunas bromas de su propia cosecha…

programme.title: El Regreso De Don Pitufo
programme.desc: Cuando una gota de la nueva poción de Papá Pitufo cae en el libro de aventuras de los Pitufitos, el héroe de ficción cobra vida. El intrépido Don Pitufo, que desea deshacer a los Pitufos del malvado Gargamel, lo captura con valentía…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Indeciso, tal como su nombre indica, no consigue decidirse sobre nada. Los otros Pitufos le llevan al bosque para hacer una prueba de supervivencia en la que únicamente pueda encontrar el camino de vuelta a casa tomando decisiones. Sin embargo, acaba en el castillo de Baltasar.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Carpintero es el encargado de arreglar todos los desperfectos en la Aldea Pitufa. Pero ¿valoran de verdad los demás Pitufos sus esfuerzos? De ningún modo. Al menos eso es lo que siente Pitufo Carpintero, quien decide abandonar la Aldea Pitufa para siempre e irse a vivir al mar con Marina, la sirena…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Mientras los Pitufos se preparan para el Festival de las Estrellas, Gargamel consigue infiltrar entre ellos una criatura que emite un olor a podrido tan intenso que le permitirá encontrar fácilmente la Aldea Pitufa. Papá Pitufo se da cuenta de que la criatura maloliente es de otro planeta, y manda a Plumífero que la devuelva a su hogar antes de que Gargamel les encuentre.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Soñador verá cumplido su deseo de ser un Astropitufo cuando Papá Pitufo le hechiza para quedarse dormido, transformando el paisaje y a los Pitufos en una fantasía galáctica. Gargamel vigila de cerca las travesuras de los Pitufos desde su bola de cristal, pero el hechizo de Papá Pitufo también tiene efecto en él y le transporta hasta el centro de una tormenta.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Pitufo Marco Y Los Piratas Pimienta
programme.desc: Los Pitufos navegan para salvar a Marco, que ha sido capturado por el Capitán Pedro Pimienta. Marina y un delfín acaban liberando a Marco.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: La Primera Navidad De Bebe Pitufo
programme.desc: La ilusión de Navidad se ve frustrada cuando Chlorhydris hechiza a San Nicolás para que no pueda repartir felicidad en Navidad. Afortunadamente, Papá Pitufo y los demás pitufos consiguen romper el hechizo y devolver la Navidad a su bosque.

programme.title: Educando A Goloso
programme.desc: Pitufo Goloso se excede. Se pone cada vez más pesado hasta que su peso lo pone en peligro. El malvado Gargamel va a atraparlo... ¿Pitufo Goloso podrá ser salvado por Papá Pitufo?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Hay un premio para aquel Pitufo que tenga la mascota más adorable. Bebé Pitufo acude con Cariño Dorado, una mascota adorable y cariñosa de la que todo el mundo se enamora. Sin embargo, esa mascota es una creación del malvado mago Gargamel con la que pretende destruir a los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos Y El Árbol Del Dinero
programme.desc: El mago malvado Gargamel ha elaborado otro plan diabólico con la ayuda de su madre, quien no es más agradable que él. Él quiere persuadir a los Pitufos con dinero pero ellos no saben lo que les espera. ¿Pitufo Goloso caerá en la trampa?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Una aventura dramática y conmovedora… Pitufina y su mascota Re chillido. La pequeña Pitufina está inundada en lágrimas. ¿Podrán los demás pitufos consolarla?

programme.title: El Concurso De Mr. Pitufo
programme.desc: Papá Pitufo decide celebrar una fiesta de la cosecha, y todos los Pitufos compiten en el concurso de «Mr. Pitufo» por el honor de ser el acompañante de Sasita. Gargamel se cuela en el concurso después de encoger su cuerpo con un tinte azul mágico, con la esperanza de capturar a todos los Pitufos cuando vuelva a su tamaño normal. Los Pitufos le echan y Sasita decide que Papá Pitufo será su acompañante.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufina guía a los Pitufos de caminata por la naturaleza, pero Puppy se adelantó demasiado y tras perseguirlo acaban en el territorio de los Wartmongers. El Rey de los Wartmongers acaba haciéndoles prisioneros en burbujas, pero un grupo de rebeldes les rescata y consiguen huir a lomos de Puppy.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Tontín y Pitufina son capturados para ser exhibidos en una Feria. Papá Pitufo aprovecha la torpeza de Gargamel para rescatarlos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Genio ha decidido dedicarse al bienestar de los demás Pitufos. Va a curarles de todos sus males…con la ayuda del malvado Gargamel!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: La Cama Voladora De Papa Pitufo
programme.desc: Gargamel lanza un hechizo a la nueva cama de Papá Pitufo para que cualquiera que duerma en ella sea transportado al lugar con el que esté soñando. Los ensueños de los Pitufos les llevan a un barco, un castillo y, por último, hasta Gargamel. Consiguen escapar cuando Pitufo Torpe se queda dormido y sueña con su hogar.

programme.title: El Pitufo Galante
programme.desc: La reina Agripina no dejará que su hijo, el príncipe Godofredo, se case con la dulce Priscila. Ella quiere como nuera a una chica que sea capaz de mostrarle algo que nunca antes haya visto. Cuando Hogata se entera y descubre la existencia de Abuelo Pitufo, está segura de que logrará sorprender a la reina con su captura. Por supuesto, Hogata debe atrapar primero a Abuelo Pitufo…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo lo ha vuelto a hacer. Además, esta vez ha sido delante de Papá Pitufo. Ha pronunciado un hechizo que convierte todo en piedra. Todo, incluyendo a él mismo y a los demás Pitufos, así como la aldea y muchos kilómetros del bosque que hay alrededor. Afortunadamente, aparece Guillermo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Fortachón se disfraza de Pitufina para atraer a Piltkin, el gnomo que se ha enamorado de ella, y alejarlo de la Aldea Pitufa. Excavan bajo tierra y conocen a una gnoma que se enamora de Piltkin, quien se olvida de Pitufina y pasa a tener ojos solo para su nueva conquista.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Pitufo Marco Y Los Piratas Pimienta
programme.desc: Los Pitufos navegan para salvar a Marco, que ha sido capturado por el Capitán Pedro Pimienta. Marina y un delfín acaban liberando a Marco.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Simón se ha perdido en el bosque buscando a sus padres, una pareja de gigantes. Los Pitufos tratarán de llevarlo de vuelta a su casa, pero gargamel aparecerá una vez más con no muy buenas intenciones.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Es la primera Navidad de Pitufo Salvaje y está impresionado por la decoración de la Aldea Pitufa. Pero Abuelo Pitufo y Sasita van a enseñarle el auténtico significado de la Navidad cuando ayudan a una pareja de ancianos a disfrutar de la Navidad más hermosa que jamás hayan vivido…

programme.title: Armonía La Estrella De La Función
programme.desc: Pitufo Armonía firma inconscientemente un contrato con Escritor Fantasma para escribir una sinfonía, lo que hace que quede atrapado en un club nocturno fantasmal para siempre. Papá Pitufo exige un juicio con un jurado y un juez de fantasmas, que declaran inocente a Pitufo Armonía y culpable de plagio a Escritor Fantasma.

programme.title: La Brigada De Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cuando en la Aldea Pitufa forman una brigada de incendios para combatir las llamas que devoran la cocina de Pitufo Goloso, se dan cuenta de que Gargamel les ha dejado sin agua. Sin embargo, no se da cuenta de la fragilidad de su presa, que se rompe y provoca que el agua arrastre a Gargamel y Azrael e inunde la Aldea Pitufa, extinguiendo el fuego.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Mientras los Pitufos se preparan para el Festival de las Estrellas, Gargamel consigue infiltrar entre ellos una criatura que emite un olor a podrido tan intenso que le permitirá encontrar fácilmente la Aldea Pitufa. Papá Pitufo se da cuenta de que la criatura maloliente es de otro planeta, y manda a Plumífero que la devuelva a su hogar antes de que Gargamel les encuentre.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Gruñón aprende que las emociones pueden ser fantásticas, sobre todo después de que la malvada Clorhidris cree un corazón de hielo para despojar a todos de la bondad y el amor.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Celoso por la atención que recibe Pitufo Vanidoso cuando se rompe un dedo del pie, Pitufo Bromista finge estar enfermo con la esperanza de que le hagan caso. Desafortunadamente, su treta se vuelve en su contra y, en lugar de amorosos cuidados, todo lo que recibe es un proverbial merecido.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Un monstruo del pantano secuestra a Bebé Pitufo como regalo para una bruja. La bruja, que cree que nadie la ama, se sorprende cuando Bebé Pitufo le demuestra afecto. Cuando Papá Pitufo acude a rescatar a Bebé Pitufo, consigue que la bruja entienda que el leal monstruo del pantano siempre la ha amado.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Hogata consigue los pendientes dorados mágicos de Sonoria, que le permitirán oír las voces de los Pitufos desde lejos. Siguiendo los ronquidos de Pitufo Perezoso, está a punto de llegar hasta la Aldea Pitufa, pero entonces los sonidos del cuerno de Pitufo Armonía comienzan a resonar en sus pendientes y huye enfurecida de vuelta a casa.

programme.title: Los Pitufos Y El Árbol Del Dinero
programme.desc: El mago malvado Gargamel ha elaborado otro plan diabólico con la ayuda de su madre, quien no es más agradable que él. Él quiere persuadir a los Pitufos con dinero pero ellos no saben lo que les espera. ¿Pitufo Goloso caerá en la trampa?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Papá Pitufo recuerda las emocionantes aventuras de Soñador en el mar, con tortugas, ballenas, islas desiertas…y piratas!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos aprenden que la mente es más fuerte que la materia gracias a un engañoso y caro tónico milagroso de un charlatán. Pero Papá Pitufo les hará ver que no es más que un charlatán.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Otra estupenda producción del teatro de los Pitufos basada en los personajes de Alejandro Dumas. Incluye algunas líneas de Romeo y Julieta. Una obra maestra de la escena.

programme.title: Los Pitufos Monstruosos
programme.desc: Es la noche de los fantasmas y todos los Pitufos se preparan para la elegante fiesta de disfraces… pero Pitufo Filósofo se hace con el libro de magia de Papá Pitufo y todos los Pitufos se transforman en criaturas horrendas, aunque divertidas. No obstante, el peligro acecha…

programme.title: La Venganza De Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Se ha desatado una guerra en la Edad Media. Unos caballeros vestidos con armadura destrozan por accidente la Aldea Pitufa, lo que provoca que una pequeña banda de Pitufos decida vengar esta afrenta. ¿No pensará Papá Pitufo que esta es una acción demasiado propia de los humanos?

programme.title: La Belleza Es Superficial
programme.desc: Periwinkle, un hada vanidosa, se molesta cuando su espejo mágico le dice que el ser más hermoso es Pitufo Vanidoso, y no ella. Periwinkle secuestra a Pitufo Vanidoso, pero los demás Pitufos acuden al rescate. Periwinkle se da cuenta de que ha obrado mal y se convierten en amigos.

programme.title: Campanas De Boda Para Gargamel
programme.desc: Los Pitufos se hacen amigos de una dama en apuros que está prometida a Gargamel, ya que convencen a su padre de que el estúpido mago está loco.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel intenta probar un nuevo hechizo en los Pitufos, pero le sale al revés y se convierte a sí mismo en piedra. Los Pitufos están locos de alegría. ¡Su archienemigo ya no les hará sufrir nunca más!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Te despiertas temprano por la mañana, antes de que los demás Pitufos se hayan levantado de sus camas, para preparar sabrosos bizcochos de pitufrutas. Dedicas toda la mañana a preparar pitufimanjares para el almuerzo. Después, toda la tarde a tener la deliciosa cena lista a tiempo. ¿Y acaso los demás Pitufos te dan siquiera las gracias? Así pues, Pitufo Goloso renuncia. La aldea está en problemas… y pronto, también lo está Pitufo Goloso.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Hogatha se disfraza de premio de oro para observar a los Pitufos y capturarlos para sus ingredientes de belleza. Vanidoso acaba convenciéndola de que pruebe su receta y acaba cubierta de barro de vuelta a casa de Gargamel.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Genio ha decidido dedicarse al bienestar de los demás Pitufos. Va a curarles de todos sus males…con la ayuda del malvado Gargamel!

programme.desc: Cheerleaders use a newcomer to exact revenge on their cheating boyfriend.

programme.title: 40 Dates and 40 Nights
programme.desc: Burned out on dating and ready to quit, Leah takes her eccentric grandma's outrageous challenge—40 dates in 40 nights for a full year of paid rent.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: San Francisco detective Nick Curran is investigating the murder of a once-celebrated rock star, and he's made a few unsettling discoveries: a bloody ice pick, a white silk scarf tied to a bedpost, and evidence of an otherwise romantic evening.

programme.title: The Silence of the Lambs
programme.desc: An FBI trainee is assigned by her superior to interview an imprisoned, cannibalistic psychopath, Hannibal the Cannibal Lecter, in the hope that he may help uncover the identity of an elusive serial killer.

programme.title: Into the Forest

programme.title: Out of Liberty

programme.title: Ne Zha
programme.desc: A young boy, with the power to destroy the world, must choose between good and evil in order to break the shackles of fate and become the hero.

programme.title: Ghost World
programme.desc: The story of neo-cool Enid and Rebecca who, faced with graduation from high school take a hard look at the world they wryly observe. When Rebecca focuses her attention on mutual romantic fixation Josh, the girls friendship is forever changed.

programme.title: The Crow: Wicked Prayer
programme.desc: The fourth film in the dark superhero franchise is an epic new action tale. After an ex-con tries to straighten out his life, he and his girlfriend are brutally murdered by a renegade gang. A mysterious crow brings him back for revenge and redemption.

programme.title: Face/Off
programme.desc: As a result of a new medical technique, an agent is able to surgically take on the identical appearance of a criminal in order to take down his terrorist organization.

programme.title: Scream

programme.title: Ferris Bueller's Day Off
programme.desc: High school senior, Ferris Bueller, decides to cut school and is determined to experience a day of pure freedom with his girlfriend and best friend in downtown Chicago before graduating.

programme.title: Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventure
programme.desc: Our non-heinous heroes Bill (Alex Winter) and Ted (Keanu Reeves) are in danger of flunking history! But when the righteous Rufus (George Carlin) arrives in a time-travelling phone booth, the dense dudes discover their destiny!

programme.title: Fat Man and Little Boy
programme.desc: In the remote desert of New Mexico, “The Manhattan Project” is materializing – the World War II effort to build the atomic bomb.

programme.title: The Untouchables
programme.desc: This confrontation between good and evil stars Kevin Costner as federal agent Eliot Ness, Robert De Niro as gangland kingpin Al Capone, and Sean Connery as Malone, the cop who teaches Ness how to beat the mob: shoot fast and shoot first.

programme.title: Narc
programme.desc: Jason Patric stars as Nick Tellis, a suspended narcotics officer recruited to investigate the murder of Michael Calvess, a rookie cop killed under mysterious circumstances.

programme.title: Hearts Beat Loud
programme.desc: A father and daughter form an unlikely songwriting duo in the summer before she leaves for college.

programme.title: The Truman Show
programme.desc: Truman doesn’t realize that his quaint hometown is a giant studio set run by a visionary producer/director/creator (Ed Harris), that folks living and working there are Hollywood actors, and that even his incessantly bubbly wife is a contract player.

programme.title: Election
programme.desc: Reese Witherspoon plays Tracy Flick, a straight-A go-getter determined to be president of Carver High’s student body. Popular teacher Jim McAllister (Broderick) decides to derail Tracy’s obsessive overachieving by recruiting an opposition candidate.

programme.title: Escape from Alcatraz
programme.desc: Superstar Clint Eastwood and director Don Siegel re-team for their fifth film in this fascinating account of the only three men ever to escape from the infamous maximum security prison at Alcatraz.

programme.title: The Friends of Eddie Coyle
programme.desc: As a small time hood Eddie is about to go back to jail. In order to escape this fate he deals information on stolen guns to the feds. Simultaneously he is supplying arms to his bank robbing/kidnapping hoodlum chums.

programme.title: World War Z
programme.desc: World War Z is the fast-paced, pulse-pounding epic of the potential last days of the human race. Former United Nations employee Gerry Lane (Brad Pitt) is called in to help stop the pandemic from spreading worldwide.

programme.title: Overlord
programme.desc: Nothing can prepare you for the mind-blowing mayhem that is Overlord. Mega producer J.J. Abrams creates an insanely twisted thrill ride about a team of American troops who come face-to-face with Nazi super-soldiers unlike the world has ever seen.

programme.title: Seabiscuit
programme.desc: The true story of the undersized Depression-era racehorse whose victories lifted not only the spirits of the team behind it but also those of the nation as well.

programme.title: The Unbearable Weight of Massive Talent
programme.desc: In this action-packed comedy, Nicolas Cage plays Nick Cage, channeling his iconic characters as he's caught between a superfan (Pedro Pascal) and a CIA agent (Tiffany Haddish).

programme.title: Bangkok Dangerous
programme.desc: A hitman who's in Bangkok to pull off a series of jobs violates his personal code when he falls for a local woman and bonds with his errand boy.

programme.title: Runaway Bride

programme.title: The Pelican Brief

programme.title: On the Come Up

programme.title: The Buccaneer
programme.desc: General Andrew Jackson's dependence on the help of pirate Jean Lafitte to repel the British is complicated by the Governor's daughter. Set in New Orleans during the War of 1812.

programme.title: The Vikings
programme.desc: Legends Kirk Douglas, Tony Curtis, Ernest Borgnine and Janet Leigh dazzle in this epic chronicle of brutal rivalry and bloodthirsty ambition as two brothers are locked in a battle that will decide their fate...and that of a beautiful princess.

programme.title: Shooter
programme.desc: Determined to prove his innocence in a double-cross, Bob Lee Swagger is now in a high-tension race from every law enforcement agency in the US and a shadowy organization that wants him dead.

programme.title: Friday the 13th, Part VI: Jason Lives
programme.desc: As a child, Tommy Jarvis did what many others died trying to do. He killed Jason Vorhees, the mass murderer who terrorized the residents of Crystal Lake. But now, years later, Tommy is tormented by the fear that maybe Jason isn’t really dead.

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part VII: The New Blood
programme.desc: Ever since homicidal maniac Jason Voorhees got trapped in chains at the bottom of Crystal Lake, the nearby summer camp has operated without a hitch... without a murder. But one of this season’s happy campers has brought along a deadly secret.

programme.title: The Golden Child
programme.desc: As ‘The Chosen One’, Murphy’s on a madcap mission to save The Golden Child, a youth with mystical powers who’s been abducted by an evil cult.

programme.title: Harlem Nights
programme.desc: In the waning days of Prohibition, Sugar Ray and his adopted son, Quick, run a speakeasy called Club Sugar Ray. Gangster Bugsy Calhoune pays corrupt cop Phil Cantone to close Club Sugar Ray down.

programme.title: The Order
programme.desc: Martial arts icon Jean-Claude Van Damme stars as a playboy criminal thrust into a dangerous world of ancient evil when he must investigate the disappearance of his archaeologist father. With Oscar winner Charlton Heston and Sofia Milos.

programme.title: Derailed
programme.desc: On an out of control train holding hostages and high-tech bio-weapons agent Kristoff (Van Damme) becomes a one man army to derail the terrorists and save the lives of everyone on board!

programme.title: Mean Girls
programme.desc: Cady thinks she understands "survival of the fittest." However, the law of the wild takes on a whole new meaning when the homeschooled 15-year-old enters public high school for the first time.

programme.title: Mean Girls (2024)
programme.desc: Cady Heron is a hit with the Plastics, an A-list girl clique at her new school, when she makes the mistake of falling for Aaron Samuels, the ex-boyfriend of alpha Plastic Regina George.

programme.title: Baggage Claim
programme.desc: Montana Moore is determined to get engaged before her sister’s wedding in just 30 days!

programme.title: Thunderheart
programme.desc: Val Kilmer, Sam Shepard, and Graham Greene star in this murder mystery filled with style and suspense. Kilmer stars as Ray Levoi, a hotshot FBI agent who's thrust into a strange new world when he is sent to solve a murder on an Indian reservation.

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: After the harrowing death of his partner, detective and best-selling author Alex Cross has retreated to the peace of retirement. But when a brilliant criminal (Michael Wincott) kidnaps a senator’s young daughter, Alex is lured back into action.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: An inspirational account of basketball coach Ken Carter, who received both praise and criticism when he made headlines for benching his entire undefeated team for poor academic performance.

programme.title: Varsity Blues
programme.desc: At first, backup quarterback Jonathan is no football star. But when the starting quarterback is injured, he is thrown into the game and also finds himself in direct conflict with his coach and girlfriend.

programme.title: Damsel
programme.desc: A businessman travels West to join his fiancée in the mountains.

programme.title: Sweet Country
programme.desc: Australian western set on the Northern Territory frontier in the 1920s, where justice itself is put on trial when an aged Aboriginal farmhand shoots a white man in self-defense and goes on the run as a posse gathers to hunt him down.

programme.title: The Spiderwick Chronicles
programme.desc: From the best-selling book series comes a fantasy adventure that reveals the unseen world all around us.

programme.title: Noah
programme.desc: Russell Crowe stars as Noah in the timeless story of courage, sacrifice, and hope. "This visually stunning, action-adventure is hailed as "one of the most unforgettable Biblical epics ever put on film." *Richard Roeper, Chicago-Sun-Times

programme.title: Pet Sematary (1989)
programme.desc: For most families, moving is a new beginning. But for the Creeds, it could be the beginning of the end because they've just moved in next door to a place that children built with broken dreams, the Pet Sematary.

programme.title: Cujo
programme.desc: While Donna and Vic Trenton struggle to save their rocky marriage, their son Tad befriends the loveable 200-lb St. Bernard who belongs to their mechanic.

programme.title: The Crow
programme.desc: Visually stunning and action-packed, this hit movie, based on the comic book series, follows the return from the grave of a young rock guitarist who, along with his fiancée, is brutally killed by a ruthless gang of criminals.

programme.title: The Crow: City of Angels
programme.desc: This fast-moving, action-packed sequel to THE CROW follows the rise of murder victim Ashe Corven, brought back to life by a mysterious crow. With the help of a woman named Sarah, he exacts revenge on his killers one by one.

programme.title: Scream 2
programme.desc: While away at college, Sidney Prescott thought she'd finally put the terror behind her...until a copycat killer begins acting out a real-life sequel in which no one is safe, or beyond suspicion.

programme.title: Scream 3
programme.desc: The first film set the rules. In the sequel, the stakes got higher. In the third installment of the hit franchise SCREAM, all bets are off. It's an insidious game of horror movie mayhem with surprising twists and turns.

programme.title: Planes, Trains & Automobiles
programme.desc: Neal just wants to fly home to Chicago for Thanksgiving with his family. But all he gets is misery. Misery named Del Griffith, a loud-mouthed salesman who leads Neal on a wild goose chase.

programme.title: Blue Chips
programme.desc: Pete Bell, a college basketball coach is under a lot of pressure. His team isn't winning. The stars of the future are being paid by other teams. This practise is forbidden in the college game, but Pete is desperate and has pressures from all around.

programme.title: School Ties
programme.desc: After receiving a scholarship to an exclusive prep school, working-class teen David Greene becomes a star athlete and wins the attention of a beautiful debutante.

programme.title: Juice
programme.desc: Q. Raheem. Bishop. Steel. They're four Harlem friends who spend their days hanging out and looking for a way to get the power and respect they call Juice. Q hopes to earn respect by becoming a scratch 'n' mix DJ.

programme.title: To Live And Die In L.A.
programme.desc: Federal agent Richard Chance has a score to settle, and he's through playing by the rules. He vows to take down a murderous counterfeiter by any means necessary. But as the stakes grow higher, will Chance's obsession ultimately destroy him?

programme.title: School of Rock
programme.desc: Jack Black stars as a guitarist with delusions of grandeur. Kicked out of his band and looking for work, he becomes a substitute teacher and turns his class into rock and rollers.

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: A high-school boy is given the chance to write a story for Rolling Stone Magazine about an up-and-coming rock band as he accompanies it on their concert tour.

programme.title: Pulp Fiction
programme.desc: Writer-director Quentin Tarantino delivers an iconic cast of characters in PULP FICTION, a wildly entertaining tale of violence and redemption. John Travolta, Samuel L. Jackson, Uma Thurman, and Bruce Willis star in this pop culture phenomenon.

programme.title: The Killer Elite
programme.desc: James Caan and Robert Duvall star in Sam Peckinpah's tense, action-packed thriller that explores savagery and betrayal in the murky world of killers-for-hire.

programme.title: Escape from Alcatraz
programme.desc: Superstar Clint Eastwood and director Don Siegel re-team for their fifth film in this fascinating account of the only three men ever to escape from the infamous maximum security prison at Alcatraz.

programme.title: Cloverfield
programme.desc: Five young New Yorkers face a life-or-death struggle to escape from the city when a monster the size of a skyscraper suddenly appears.

programme.title: World War Z
programme.desc: World War Z is the fast-paced, pulse-pounding epic of the potential last days of the human race. Former United Nations employee Gerry Lane (Brad Pitt) is called in to help stop the pandemic from spreading worldwide.

programme.title: We Were Soldiers
programme.desc: In 1965, America is at war with North Vietnam, and Lt. Col. Hal Moore prepares his troops for one of the most violent battles in U.S. History: “The Valley of Death.”

programme.title: Defiance
programme.desc: Defiance is a riveting adventure that showcases the extraordinary true story of the Bielski brothers, simple farmers -outnumbered and outgunned- who turned a group of war refugees into powerful freedom fighters.

programme.title: Bad Moms
programme.desc: Pushed beyond their limits, three overworked and stressed-out mothers (Mila Kunis, Kristen Bell, Kathryn Hahn) go wild after ditching their daily routines.

programme.title: I Feel Pretty
programme.desc: Renee is an ordinary gal who struggles with feelings of insecurity and inadequacy. After awakening from a fall, she suddenly gains a renewed sense of self-confidence that makes her believe she is the most beautiful and capable woman on the planet.

programme.title: The Mexican
programme.desc: A man tries to transport an ancient gun called The Mexican, believed to carry a curse, back across the border, while his girlfriend pressures him to give up his criminal ways.

programme.title: Albany Road
programme.desc: On her way to the most important meeting of her career, a New York executive is forced to share a rental car with her ex-fiancé's mother, only to discover that the mother is hiding a major secret.

programme.title: Shutter Island
programme.desc: When U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels arrives at the asylum for the criminally insane on Shutter Island, he uncovers terrifying truths about the island. He finds out that some places never let you go.

programme.title: Titanic
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio and Oscar-nominee Kate Winslet light up the screen as Jack and Rose, the young lovers who find one another on the maiden voyage of the "unsinkable" R.M.S. Titanic.

programme.title: Rocky V
programme.desc: Broke and injured after his bout with Russian powerhouse Ivan Drago, Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) must rediscover his roots in this thrill-packed drama that reunites Stallone with John G. Avildsen, the Oscar®-winning director of 'Rocky.'

programme.title: Rocky Balboa
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone is back in this action-packed sequel, and this time he's up against an opponent (Antonio Tarver) who's faster, stronger, and 30 years his junior! Milo Ventimiglia and Burt Young are ringside for the hard-hitting battle of the ages!

programme.title: Down to Earth
programme.desc: Struggling black comic Lance Barton (Chris Rock) knows what it's like to die on stage. But when his life takes an unexpected turn - straight to heaven - Lance is sure there's been a mistake.

programme.title: Top Five
programme.desc: Written, directed and starring Chris Rock, TOP FIVE tells the story of New York City comedian-turned-film star Andre Allen, whose unexpected encounter with a journalist forces him to confront the comedy career—and the past—that he’s left behind.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The continuing saga of a young Vito Corleone growing up in Sicily and New York during the 1910s, then following Michael Corleone in the 1950s as he tries to expand the family business.

programme.title: LaRoy, Texas
programme.desc: Broke and depressed, Ray (John Magaro) is mistaken for a dangerous hitman and given an envelope of cash. Along with his P.I. friend Skip (Steve Zahn), he must escape the actual hitman to make it out of LaRoy alive.

programme.title: Silk Road (2021)
programme.desc: Ross launches the website Silk Road, an anonymous drug market, catching the focus of DEA agent Rick. As their private lives erode, they are trapped in a game of cat-and-mouse.

programme.title: Mystery Science Theater 3000: Untamed Youth

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester athletes Kim Rhode and Desiree Edmonds share what it takes to compete at the highest level of clay target shooting. From the pressure of national competition to the routines that build confidence, they reveal how preparation, mental focus, and years of dedication lead to success. The transcript emphasizes that managing pressure is a learned skill, supported by consistent routines and trust in dependable equipment like Winchester AA shotshells. As the two champions train, mentor the next generation, and reflect on the journeys that shaped their careers, the episode celebrates more than trophies. With Kim's Olympic legacy and Desi's Hall of Fame induction, the passion, perseverance, and commitment to excellence that continue to inspire shooters across the country.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.sub-title: The Journey Within - "Eastern Cape of South Africa: Blue Duiker with Dogs
programme.desc: Join Mark Peterson as he continues his hunting journey through the Eastern Cape of South Africa. In this episode, Mark takes on a unique challenge: pursuing the elusive blue duiker, one of Africa's smallest and most difficult antelope species to hunt. Watch as he teams up with local houndsman Robin and a specialized pack of dogs to flush these rabbit-sized trophies from thick coastal vegetation. Experience the fast-paced action of shotgun hunting for quick-moving targets in dense cover, where success depends on split-second timing and expert dog work.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.sub-title: The Journey Within - "Orange Free State of South Africa: White Blesbuck, Tsessebe & More
programme.desc: Mark Peterson's South African adventure continues! In this episode, he takes on the rugged terrain of the Orange Free State while pursuing four unique and challenging trophy species. Watch as Mark puts his spot-and-stalk skills to the test against the lightning-fast Kalahari Springbok and the elusive Common Reedbuck hidden in thick cover. The intensity builds as he and the crew track the striking White Blesbuck across the open plains and pursue the Tsessebe — one of the fastest antelope species in Africa.

programme.title: Greg Morton
programme.sub-title: I Started Out, as a Baby
programme.desc: Greg Morton had only two choices in schoolyard conflicts. Learn the ways of the force, or use his wit to diffuse situations. That wit would soon lead to winning first prize in the, ‘So You Think You're Funny Contest' and the beginning of his stand-up comedy career. He was no longer the shy introverted kid, drawing cartoons in the corner. He had finally found his voice. A voice he would later use to direct and voice over twenty Saturday Morning cartoons. This former mobile disc jockey, who used to play songs at weddings, now sings song parodies on nationally syndicated radio shows, like the Bob and Tom Show. Take his Obama Man, sung to the tune of Candy Man, which has racked up over 4 million hits on YouTube.

programme.title: Billy Anderson
programme.desc: Born in Texas and raised in Augusta, Georgia – Billy Anderson is stand-up comedian currently living in Seattle, Washington. He's been seen regionally at SketchFest Seattle, The Washington Comedy Festival, Bumbershoot and was a finalist in the 2016 Seattle International Comedy Competition. Outside of the Northwest, Billy has written for Cracked.Com, performed in SF Sketchfest, LaLaFest Los Angeles, the San Francisco International Comedy Competition and as of 2013 he has performed stand-up comedy in every US state. Billy was recently featured on Audible's “Sounds Like America” hosted by Jackie Kashian and the syndicated program “Laughs” on Fox television.

programme.title: Drew Barth
programme.desc: Drew Barth is one of the fastest rising comedy stars in the Northwest. Born just outside the city of Seattle, what started as a dare in high school has become a full-time career. Drew Barth has risen through the ranks of local open mics to become a regular performer at comedy clubs, colleges, casinos and private events up and down the West Coast. After making the finals of the Seattle International Comedy Competition, Drew Barth spent a great deal of time in Los Angeles performing at clubs such as The Comedy Store, Laugh Factory, and The Improv, honing his craft.

programme.title: Christian Pieper
programme.desc: Christian Pieper is an award-winning and crowd-pleasing comedian from Beaver Dam, Kentucky, now living in Los Angeles. In just five years as a performer, Christian has quickly earned acclaim for his honest, smart, and welcoming approach to personal material, layering unexpectedly subversive observations on current events, culture, and relationships.A two-time semifinalist in the prestigious Boston Comedy Festival, hes also been featured in the Crossroads Comedy Festival, Burbank Comedy Festival, and other festivals and competitions across the country. Christian has also performed abroad, having done shows for troops and civilians in eight different countries, and was a guest on the Bob & Tom show. He currently hosts and produces Adrenaline, a comedy-challenge show presented regularly at Wiseguys Comedy Club in Salt Lake City and the Hollywood Improv.

programme.title: Baby Einstein

Besides being music to your ears, these baby steps of language change everything as your little one discovers an exciting, powerful new way of relating to the world! Baby's First Sounds invites both of you to share these memorable moments: those precious ''firsts'' that come around once in your baby's lifetime.

programme.title: Baby Einstein

programme.title: Baby Einstein

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.sub-title: Baby Einstein: Let's Learn Signs: Family and Home

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

Mr. Longface stops by and Strawberry offers him some fresh applesauce but he declines, as he doesn't care for it. programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Lemon is ecstatic. She races out of her salon and goes around to the other girls' houses proclaiming that she "did it!" and beckoning them to join her. They are brightly colored, jeweled manicures with tiny microchips inside that play songs when the wearer moves her hand. programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

Just as it floats close, she gives it a bat sending it outside and the Berrykins happily chasing after it. Wanting in on the fun, she joins them.

The twins begin to announce, and then argue, that they are starting a club - a good citizens club. The girls are shocked as the twins argue with each other all the time.

programme.title: Blippi's Holiday Special 2022

programme.title: The Berry Best Treasure
programme.desc: Cherry Jam is being driven to distraction! She can't finish a song that she promised to write for a singing group, thanks to the earsplitting noise from Berrykin construction crews who are trying to find the sparkleberry juice blockage that has shut down the town's power. Strawberry can't cook in the café, Lemon's hair salon appliances are running out of control—life in Berry Bitty City is impossible! Strawberry rallies their spirits by suggesting a fun way for them to spend the day out of town: a treasure hunt! She describes a game where the girls divide into two teams, and each team creates fun written clues for the other that lead to funny objects the girls must collect.

programme.title: The Berry Scary Fun Adventure
programme.desc: With the power completely out in Berry Bitty City, the girls go on a camping trip to be out of the way of the Berrykin work crews. Lemon is nervous because she believes there is a creepy creature in the forest (that she read about in a book Blueberry loaned her), and the girls get the nervous bug, but Strawberry turns their apprehension into fun by daring her friends to stay out in the woods the longest! Rallied by a sense of competition and adventure, the girls divide into three groups and set up tents—each convinced they will be the bravest group. They each come up with diverting activities to distract themselves.

programme.title: Fallen Angel
programme.desc: Blue Angel slowly begins whittling away Playmaker's Life Points using her Trickstar deck. Yusaku manages to fight back and Aoi is forced to use the mysterious card that the Knights of Hanoi gave her.

programme.title: A Storm is Coming
programme.desc: Aoi is left in a coma after he duel with Yusaku. A grieving Akira lures Playmaker into a trap to get the program to heal her. That's when Revolver, Hanoi's leader appears, and challenges Yusaku to a duel with Aoi's fate on the line.

programme.title: Blippi Visits an Orange Farm
programme.desc: Join Blippi as he visits Showcase of Citrus Orange Farm in Clermont, Florida.

programme.title: The Berry Lucky Day
programme.desc: The girls are driven to distraction by their frisky puppies frolicking all over Berry Bitty City! Full of energy and thinking that everything in town is a toy for them to play with, they cause comical mayhem wherever they go. Strawberry suggests the pups need a place of their own where they can play—a dog park! The girls decide to call in Huckleberry, who runs an animal hotel in Berry Big City, to help design the park. With Huck on his way, Cherry practices her singing. She believes her ability to hit a perfect high note is the result of a good luck charm—a beautiful crystal — that she keeps in her pocket. Although Strawberry says singing isn't about luck, but about practice and hard work, Cherry isn't convinced.

programme.title: All Dogs Allowed
programme.desc: The girls plan a formal afternoon lawn party tea to inaugurate their new dog park. Plum is in charge of decorations, Cherry music, and Strawberry snacks. There's even a giant, dog-shaped ice sculpture. As the girls get dressed, Raspberry puts the finishing touches on the high-fashion hats that will accompany their beautiful gowns. At last everything is ready. But when the gate opens... the puppies back away! For some strange reason, they want nothing to do with the dog park! No matter how the girls call them to come in, the pups hesitate and back away, with worried whines. Cherry tries to tempt them by hiding doggie treats around the park, but the pups just run in, snatch the treats and run out. Debate begins about why the pups won't enter the park. Everyone has their own theory. Strawberry wonders if something is scaring them. Blueberry concludes it's Lemon's ice sculpture.

programme.title: James Brown
programme.sub-title: James Brown - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Back in 1981, legendary American singer James Brown gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. The "Godfather of Soul", "Mr. Dynamite", and "Soul Brother No. 1" was a major force in 20th century popular music, influencing many musicians in numerous genres.

programme.title: Christian McBride
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn' at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Sammy Davis Jr
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On May 28, 1967, American singer and actor Sammy Davis Jr. appeared at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam for a live, nationwide TV broadcast. Supported by his band conducted by George Rhodes, Davis Jr. combined his singing talent and infectious sense of humor as he covered songs from a variety of genres.

programme.title: Rahsaan Roland Kirk
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Larry Graham
programme.sub-title: Larry Graham: Ultimate Funk at the Bataclan
programme.desc: This recording brings a great performance by Larry Graham & Graham Central Station from Bataclan in Paris. Numerous ‘funkateers' came together to cheer the bass player and funk hero. In the sixties, Graham was mainly known for his work with Sly and the Family Stone, the popular and influential psychedelic soul and funk band. As founder and front man of Graham Central Station he has also enjoyed a successful solo career. It is often said that Graham pioneered the art of slap-pop playing on the electric bass, which has become a staple of modern funk. During this Paris performance, Graham shows he is one of the heroes of funk!

programme.title: Herbert Blomstedt & Gewandhausorchester Leipzig
programme.sub-title: Symphonies in D by Mozart and Voríšek
programme.desc: Conductor Herbert Blomstedt and the Gewandhausorchester take us on a musical journey to the Czech Republic in this 2020 concert from Leipzig's Gewandhaus. The program opens with Bohemian composer Jan Václav Hugo Voríšek's Symphony in D major, Op. 23 (1821). Although the composition – Voríšek's only symphony – was never performed during the composer's lifetime, it has become one of his most-performed works today. Also on the program is Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Symphony No. 38 in D major, K. 504. This work, which premiered while Mozart was visiting Prague in 1787, is often referred to as the ‘Prague Symphony'.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven's well-known Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. With Sir Simon Rattle's mischievous enthusiasm, this famous heavyweight symphony sounds new again. This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke's in London, UK, on September 23, 2020.

programme.title: Nikolay Lugansky
programme.sub-title: Piano works by Rachmaninoff, Beethoven & Glazunov
programme.desc: Russian pianist Nikolay Lugansky has received world-wide praise for his interpretations of the music of Sergei Rachmaninoff. In this wonderful recital, the great pianist presents works by the Russian Romantic composer as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov. Lugansky opens his concert with Beethoven's Piano Sonata No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 27 No. 2, ‘Moonlight', followed by Alexander Glazunov's Piano Sonata No. 2 in E minor, Op. 75. Then Lugansky performs a selection of works by Rachmaninoff: Rachmaninoff's piano transcription of J. S. Bach's Partita No. 3 in E major a selection of Études-Tableaux (Nos. 1, 2, 4, and 8, Op, 33, and Nos. 5 and 6, Op. 39) Lilac (Op. 21, No. 5) Prelude in C minor, Op. 23 No. 7 and Rachmaninoff's transcription of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Lullaby (Op. 16 No. 1). This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on June 4, 2021.

programme.title: Evgeny Kissin, Nikolai Demidenko, Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra & Antoni Wit
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21. Soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin. After performing the first concerto, Demidenko encores with Chopin's Mazurka Op. 17/4. Kissin closes the concert with Chopin's Etude Op. 10/12 and the Waltz in E minor, Op. post. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010. Chopin composed the second concerto one year before the Concerto No. 1 and completed both works at the age of 20, before leaving his home country Poland and moving to Paris.

programme.title: Nirvana
programme.desc: Very few bands have had a musical and social impact on the world however, in its short but monumental career Nirvana certainly did both. This film features powerful footage of the band in action, both in concert and in the studio. In addition, we a team of leading music critics and insiders including Miti Adhikari, the producer of 1991's historic BBC sessions, and Kurt Cobain's biographer Charles R. Cross. Features highlights from: Smells Like Teen Spirit, Heart Shaped Box, Rape Me, Sliver, Negative Creep, Pennyroyal Tea and more...

programme.title: Evanescence
programme.desc: In 2003, Evanescence released Fallen, one of the most decade-defining albums (and one of the most successful debut albums of all time) and have gone on to became one of the most well-loved & respected bands of their generation. In the 15 years since their debut, Evanescence founder and lead-singer, Amy Lee, toured the world, has scored motion picture films and even took a 3 year break to start a family. In late 2017, Evanescence re-emerged from their hiatus with Synthesis—a reimagining of their best-known songs with orchestra & electronics and an accompanying sold-out and highly-acclaimed world tour. On November 3, 2017 Evanescence performed “Synthesis Live” in front of a sold out crowd at the Grand Theater at Foxwoods Casino in CT.

programme.title: Alabama and Friends
programme.desc: Join superstar band Alabama in a once in a lifetime concert event, recorded at the historic Ryman Auditorium, featuring on stage collaborations with country's biggest stars: Luke Bryan, Jason Aldean, Trisha Yearwood, Florida Georgia Line, Jamey Johnson and the Eli Young Band. Experience timeless tunes 'Tennessee River', 'Love In The First Degree', 'I'm In A Hurry (And Don't Know Why)', 'My Home's In Alabama', and more.

programme.title: Beck
programme.desc: Discreet genie, it's a Music-Man (with capital Ms) that's coming to Eurockennes. Since Loser in 1993, Beck trims his mix of styles. Sometimes groove, sometimes soft, sometimes rock, psyched or hip-hop. Beck, multi-instrumentalist and talented producer has offered to the last twenty years, it must be admitted, serious masterpieces.

programme.title: ZZ Top
programme.desc: With an unchanged line-up stretching back to 1969 and global album sales in excess of 50 million, ZZ Top continue to delight fans around the world with brilliant live concerts and great music. The band has made a number of visits to Montreux over the years and this concert from the 2013 Festival is undoubtedly one of their finest live performances. The set list blends tracks from early seventies albums such as "Tres Hombres" and "Fandango" through their eighties blockbuster period with "Eliminator" and "Afterburner" and up to their most recent release and return to their blues roots with "La Futura". The middle section of the concert features a jazz-blues tribute to the late Montreux Festival founder Claude Nobs with guest appearances by Mike Flanigin on Hammond Organ and Van Wilks on guitar. ZZ Top, the "lil' ol' band from Texas", are rocking the blues as strongly as ever! Music video by ZZ Top __© 2013 Montreux Sounds (/RTS), under exclusive license to Eagle Rock Entertainment Ltd.

programme.title: The Shop
programme.desc: Amazing guests, unheard stories and fresh cuts. Just another day at The Shop.This week, Maverick Carter and Paul Rivera chop it up with an exceptional group: Simu Liu, Tobe Nwigwe, Baron Davis and Calvin Johnson. Simu talks about his unique journey from being an accountant to starring in one of Marvel’s biggest films — establishing himself as a movie star. Tobe talks about his own experience in film, transitioning from football to music and his Nigerian upbringing. Baron breaks down being a multi-faceted creative, navigating his passions outside of basketball and his first-hand experience of “Linsanity.” Calvin discusses his legendary NFL career, his relationship with the Lions organization and the importance of having confidence instilled at a young age. The guys also dive into entrepreneurship, their personal businesses and much more.

programme.title: The Shop
programme.desc: The crew is back! Paul Rivera and Maverick Carter sit with a star-studded group this week: Johnny Manziel, GloRilla, mgk, Hit-Boy and Alycia Baumgardner. Johnny and the guys analyze his legendary college career, the good and the bad, his growth over the years and reminisce on his past working relationship with Maverick. mgk talks about coming up in Cleveland, memories being more valuable than money and being in the rap game for respect. GloRilla talks about the come-up, her family’s early reactions to her music, money management and the importance of having a strong team. Hit-Boy discusses his relationship with his father Big Hit, from making music to making up for lost time, career production highlights and bad publishing deals. Alycia walks the group through her approach in the ring, integrity as an athlete and representation as a woman in boxing. You don’t want to miss this one.

programme.title: The Shop
programme.desc: For episode 7, we got a very special group together. Andre 3000, LeBron James, Sexyy Red, Jerry Lorenzo, Jiaoying Summers, and Nigel Sylvester sit down with Maverick Carter and Paul Rivera for an unforgettable conversation. Andre discusses the early days of Outkast and the Dungeon Family, the legacy of Rico Wade, his love for the flute and a lot more. LeBron talked about aspiring to be something greater when growing up, his favorite Andre verses ever and having out-of-body experiences on the court. Sexyy breaks down how she first started rapping, how she deals with nerves before hitting the stage and the importance of timing. Jerry talks about the how his faith drives his creativity and decision-making, not wanting people to put a label on him and more. Jiaoying hilariously gives us insight into her comedy style, how she got her start and performing at The Apollo. Nigel talks coming up in Queens, New York, when he first found his love of bicycle riding and how he approaches brand-building.

programme.title: Timeless Patriotism: Guam and WWII
programme.desc: Timeless Patriotism: Guam and World War II focuses on how this American territory and its residents dealt with the horrific Japanese occupation of their island in WWII. There were many acts of heroism and resistance by the locals until liberation came for this American territory in 1944. Each year, unknown to most Americans on the U.S. mainland, Guamanians hold an incredible and inspirational annual liberation parade.

programme.title: Corpsman! Pearl Harbor
programme.desc: Harry Chandler arrived at Pearl Harbor in September 1941, serving as a United States Navy Corpsman. He believed his time in Hawaii would be paradise, a stark contrast to the cold winters of New England. However, on December 7, 1941, Harry's world was shaken by the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor and the island of Oahu. On that Day of Infamy, his duty became saving lives and retrieving charred bodies from the harbor's waters. Corpsman! Pearl Harbor, narrated by sports commentator Jim Nantz, follows Harry's story on that day and the days that followed America's sudden entry into World War II, while also examining the role of corpsmen and medics during the war.

programme.title: Village of Death: Oradour-Sur-Glane 1944
programme.desc: In response to French Resistance activities in the area and the D-Day landing of June 6, 1944, a German SS division arrived in the French village of Oradour-sur-Glane on June 10, 1944, and massacred 643 innocent civilians. It was one of the worst atrocities of World War II. Four hundred women and children were taken into the village church and murdered. The men were shot. Only seven people managed to escape. Following World War II, French President Charles De Gaulle ordered the village to be forever preserved and today, Oradour-sur-Glane remains as it was when the SS soldiers came in June 1944. Pots stay on the stove; cars are parked in front of houses; and sewing machines collect rust in the rubble. Oradour remains a monument to the brutality of war and how civilians paid the price in WWII when the battle passed through their town, city, or village. Narrated by actor Jeff Daniels, the film captures the lasting impact that this atrocity had on the region and the world at large.

programme.title: Rommel: The Soldier, The Son, and Hitler
programme.desc: ROMMEL: THE SOLDIER, THE SON, AND HITLER provides rare insight into the military career and personal life of Germany's most famous WWII commander, Field Marshal Erwin Rommel. Told from the perspective of Erwin's son Manfred, it is the story of what happens when a career soldier runs afoul of a dictator.Highly decorated and one of Hitler's favorite commanders in the early years of World War II, the Desert Fox, as his British adversaries labeled him, was somewhat of an enigma. Never a member of the Nazi party, Rommel detested the blending of politics and war. He would quickly discover that both were always in play in Hitler's Germany.Rommel was somewhat nave to Hitler's ways until the latter days of the Afrika Korps defeat in North Africa in 1943. By then, Rommel started to surmise that Germany's fate was sealed. In charge of the famed and flawed Atlantic Wall in western Europe in late 1943, Rommel tried his best to prepare France for the Allied invasion. In the end, it would not be enough. D-Day's success only reinforced Rommel's belief that Adolf Hitler should sue for peace in the west.It was an opinion that Hitler found treasonous.

programme.title: Lifeline: Pearl Harbor's Unknown Hero
programme.desc: Narrated by actor Gary Sinise, LIFELINE: PEARL HARBOR'S UNKNOWN HERO tells the story of how U.S. Navy sailor Joe George became an unlikely hero when the Japanese attacked Pearl Harbor in Hawaii on December 7, 1941, and how he was recognized with a Bronze Medal for his actions more than 70 years later.A USS Vestal crewman, Joe was not your model navy sailor. He fought both inside and outside the boxing ring, liked his beer a little too much at times, and had a stubborn and defiant streak that often left him at odds with his superior officers and, once in a while, got him thrown in the brig. But on that Day of Infamy, Joe did something extraordinary. He became one of Americas first heroes of WWII.Ignoring a direct order to cut the lines from the USS Vestal, which was moored alongside the burning and sinking USS Arizona, the sailor made a crucial decision that saved six lives and impacted future generations. Joe could see that the crewmen were injured badly, trapped, waving, and pleading for help as fire raged on the Arizona's deck beneath them. He found a weighted heaving line and threw it toward the men, who secured the line. One by one, they began to crawl over to the USS Vestal, hand over hand, and more than 50 feet above the water, feeling the heat from the flames on their skin. More than a thousand Arizona crewmen died during the attack, with only 335 sailors surviving that day, including the six that Joe rescued.Joe was never recognized for his actions until the men he saved from the USS Arizona (Lauren Bruner and Donald Stratton) took it upon themselves to see he received the award he deserved. With the support of Stratton's son Randy, and George's daughter Joe Ann Taylor, the men of the USS Arizona took their mission all the way to the Oval Office, the Pentagon and Capitol Hill. They were determined to complete one final mission as USS Arizona crewmen.

programme.title: The U-Boat and the Rocket
programme.desc: During World War II, the Germans had two deadly weapons in their arsenal the U-Boat and the V-2 rocket. The new documentary film THE U-BOAT AND THE ROCKET chronicles the wartime development of the V-2, which was the worlds first long-range guided ballistic missile, and Germanys attempts to deploy the weapon from its formidable U-Boats. Woven into this history is the tale of two German brothers who were each involved with the secretive mission for the Third Reich. Ernst Steinhoff was Wernher von Brauns assistant for guidance control on the V-2, and Friedrich Steinhoff was a U-boat captain-lieutenant. Rich with archival footage and interviews with historical experts, THE U-BOAT AND THE ROCKET recounts Germany's creation and testing of the rocket, and the story of the two brothers who ultimately met different fates at the end of the war. Ernst and Wernher von Braun were invited to come to the U.S. in Operation Paperclip, the secret United States intelligence program which employed German scientists after Germany surrendered. Both Ernst and von Braun were subsequently inaugurated in the International Space Hall of Fame as pioneers of the Space Age. For Friedrich, the outcome was very different. After surrendering his U-Boat, he was brutally interrogated by US naval agents and allegedly committed suicide in a New England prison.

programme.title: Women Outward Bound
programme.desc: A young girl today might have a hard time believing there was a time when girls were not supposed to do what boys were doing. To them, it's normal to compete in sports, be strong, and get gritty while enjoying the outdoors. But that wasn't the case in the 1960s, when girls were expected to be delicate, clean and demure, while aspiring to secure a husband and keep house.Yet in 1965, these stereotypes didnt stop 24 adventurous young women from setting out to paddle canoes into the wilderness and live in the woods of Minnesota without any food or shelter, and who in the process, broke barriers.WOMEN OUTWARD BOUND profiles the first group of young women to participate in the rigorous U.S. Outward Bound wilderness school in 1965 and chronicles their experiences in the wild. It also captures how one month in the woods taught them they could do more than they ever thought possible. During their experience, the young women forged a special bond, and at a reunion 47 years later, the group reminisce about the lessons they learned and the memories they made, with some surprising revelations. They didnt realize it at the time, but they were a part of changing the course of history.The documentary takes the viewer on a journey over many decades with rare archival footage, personal diary entries, family home videos, photos and aerial footage of the challenging Boundary Waters Canoe Area Wilderness. In the end, the girls proved that they could always handle the difficult challenges given by naturethey just needed to be given the chance.
